name: GitHub
description: Access repositories, issues, pull requests, and code on GitHub
description_zh: 访问 GitHub 上的仓库、Issue、Pull Request 和代码

mcp_config.name: github
mcp_config.description: GitHub - repositories, issues, PRs, code search, file operations

auth.help_text: Create a Personal Access Token at github.com/settings/tokens with repo scope
auth.help_text_zh: 在 github.com/settings/tokens 创建具有 repo 权限的个人访问令牌

name: GitLab
description: Access GitLab repositories, merge requests, and CI/CD pipelines
description_zh: 访问 GitLab 仓库、合并请求和 CI/CD 流水线

mcp_config.name: gitlab
mcp_config.description: GitLab - projects, merge requests, issues, CI/CD pipelines

auth.help_text: Create a Personal Access Token with api scope in GitLab settings
auth.help_text_zh: 在 GitLab 设置中创建具有 api 权限的个人访问令牌

name: Sentry
description: Monitor errors and performance issues tracked in Sentry
description_zh: 监控 Sentry 中追踪的错误和性能问题

mcp_config.name: sentry
mcp_config.description: Sentry error monitoring - issues, events, releases, performance

auth.help_text: Create an auth token at sentry.io Settings → API → Auth Tokens
auth.help_text_zh: 在 sentry.io 设置 → API → Auth Tokens 创建认证令牌

name: Code Review Graph
description: Code knowledge graph MCP server: impact radius of a change, execution flows, communities, architecture overview, graph search and wiki generation
description_zh: 代码知识图谱 MCP 服务器：改动影响半径、执行流、社区划分、架构概览、图谱检索与 Wiki 生成

mcp_config.name: code-review-graph
mcp_config.description: Code knowledge graph - impact radius, execution flows, communities, architecture overview, search, wiki

auth.help_text: No API key required. Needs the uv tool (uvx) and Python 3.10+. The first start downloads several hundred MB of dependencies.
auth.help_text_zh: 无需 API Key。需要 uv 工具（uvx）与 Python 3.10+，首次启动会下载数百 MB 依赖。

name: CodeGraph
description: Code knowledge graph MCP server: one explore tool returns the relevant symbols' source and call paths for a task
description_zh: 代码知识图谱 MCP 服务器：一个探索工具按任务返回相关符号的源码与调用路径

mcp_config.name: codegraph
mcp_config.description: CodeGraph - explore the symbols and call paths of an indexed project

auth.help_text: No API key required. Needs Node.js. Run `npx @colbymchenry/codegraph init` once in each project to build its index; it creates a .codegraph/ folder in that project.
auth.help_text_zh: 无需 API Key，需要 Node.js。每个项目先运行一次 `npx @colbymchenry/codegraph init` 建立索引，会在该项目里创建 .codegraph/ 目录。

name: Gitee
description: Access Gitee repositories, pull requests, issues, and code search
description_zh: 访问 Gitee 仓库、Pull Request、Issue 和代码搜索

mcp_config.name: gitee
mcp_config.description: Gitee - repositories, pull requests, issues, code search, notifications

auth.help_text: Create a Personal Access Token at gitee.com/personal_access_tokens with projects, pull_requests, issues scopes
auth.help_text_zh: 在 gitee.com/personal_access_tokens 创建个人访问令牌，勾选 projects、pull_requests、issues 权限

name: Gitee Enterprise
description: Access Gitee Enterprise repositories, pull requests, issues with enterprise-level management
description_zh: 访问 Gitee 企业版仓库、Pull Request、Issue，支持企业级管理操作

mcp_config.name: gitee-enterprise
mcp_config.description: Gitee Enterprise - enterprise repositories, pull requests, issues, team management

auth.help_text: Get your Enterprise MCP access token from Gitee Enterprise admin panel. Default API base: https://api.gitee.com/enterprises
auth.help_text_zh: 从 Gitee 企业版管理后台获取 MCP 访问令牌。默认 API 地址：https://api.gitee.com/enterprises
